scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A projective fourfold with large fundamental group and non-Stein universal cover” (preprints/A-projective-fourfold-with-large-fundamental-group-and-non-Stein-universal-cover-October-5-2026/large-fundamental-group-non-stein.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 046 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bb2a84e535643f76), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist a smooth connected projective complex fourfold X and a simple abelian surface A ⊂ X such that (1) X has large fundamental group; (2) im π1(A) → π1(X)  ≃ Z. The universal cover e X contains no positive-dimensional compact complex analytic subvariety and is not Stein. Date: October 5, 2026. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification. 32Q30, 14F35, 20F67, 14K12.
